propositions: no_file_impact_reason is hashed raw by material_basis() and material_fingerprint(), causing boundary/trailing whitespace edits to produce different fingerprints and stale attestations
The original whitespace-normalization contract requires insignificant whitespace to not invalidate certified reviews, but the reason field violates this invariant

The fix threads an independent normalize_reason parameter (defaulting True) through material_basis, material_fingerprint, and current_material_fingerprint_impl to canonicalize boundary/trailing reason whitespace
_legacy_material_ok must explicitly preserve raw-reason hashing for all three historical generations (pre-330c, post-330c/pre-2be7, and post-2be7/pre-fix) to maintain byte-exact compatibility
Interior whitespace or word changes to no_file_impact_reason remain material and produce stale-material verdicts after the fix
Whitespace-only variants (leading blank line, trailing space, trailing newline) of no_file_impact_reason must produce identical current fingerprints and certified attestations after normalization
